source: schemas/release-schema.json index_columns (sda-release-sample-1) plus atlas metadata fields; metadata_v2 from metadata/v2/schema_v2.json (sda-sample-metadata-2)

catalog.gsm: GEO sample (canonical GSM of its content group)
catalog.gse: all GEO series listing the GSM, joined with '+'; the split is computed on this string
catalog.published_gse: series folder of the sample: samples/<published_gse>/<gsm>
catalog.source_pipeline: sda-all (agent standardization, independent scorer) or hesrt (H&E Visium/ST, human review)
catalog.source_release: SDA-All scorer version of the batch, sda-all-gap-20261009, or hesrt-v1.3
catalog.technology: technology as written by the authors
catalog.expression_state: counts (integer X) / non-integer / unknown (SDA-All: as declared and scored)
catalog.coordinate_units: units of obsm['spatial']: um / pixel / native_grid / unstated
catalog.um_per_unit: micrometres per coordinate unit when known
catalog.has_spatial_um: obsm['spatial_um'] present (micrometre copy of non-um coordinates)
catalog.image_um_per_px: micrometres per image.tif pixel when known
catalog.image_registration: VERIFIED / PARTIAL / UNRESOLVED / FAILED / ABSENT (modality acceptance), WITHHELD (HESRT review FAIL: no image delivered), HESRT_HUMAN_REVIEW, empty = no registrable image
catalog.segmentation: cell / nucleus boundary acceptance (sources in sample.json)
catalog.molecules_use: positions_only: molecules without usable cell IDs
catalog.flags: units_unstated / attested / summary_features_in_matrix / hesrt_review_fail / hesrt_fail_image_released / image_partial_coverage / image_review_fail
catalog.review_decision: latest author review of this expression file: PASS / FAIL / UNSURE
catalog.aliases: GSMs with identical content not listed as rows
catalog.frozen_paper_evaluation_eligible: false for daily additions after the paper release (not part of the frozen paper evaluation cohort); empty for paper-release samples [client description]
catalog.review_kind: kind of review that admitted a daily addition, e.g. human; empty for paper-release samples [client description]
catalog.review_model: model of a delegated review, when one was used; empty otherwise [client description]
catalog.review_evidence_sha256: SHA256 of delegated review evidence, when recorded [client description]

metadata.disease: disease as reported in GEO; not harmonized to an ontology (atlas-sample-metadata.jsonl)
metadata.condition: condition or group label as reported in GEO; not harmonized
metadata.age: age as reported, with its original unit; not harmonized
metadata.sex: sex as reported (e.g. male / M / female / F); not harmonized
metadata.donor_id: donor identifier as reported, when available
metadata.publication_pmid: PubMed ID linked to the sample or its series
metadata.counts_ready: source-bound counts-capability check: VERIFIED / UNRESOLVED / ABSENT, or NOT_RECORDED (HESRT)

metadata_v2.platform: metadata v2: harmonised platform family (v3 platform, corrected where the GEO series text names another assay; see changes_v2.csv) (v3 value: platform_v3)
metadata_v2.organism: metadata v2: species the tissue comes from (host species for metagenome labels; first species for mixed entries; for a xenograft the graft species as GEO lists it first) (v3 value as written in GEO: organism_v3)
metadata_v2.sex: metadata v2: male / female / mixed / unknown (coded values without a stated key, e.g. 1/2, stay unknown) (v3 value as reported: sex_v3)
metadata_v2.review_category: metadata v2: author review category in English (v3: review_category_v3)
metadata_v2.review_notes: metadata v2: author review note in English (v3: review_notes_v3)
metadata_v2.organ: organ or body site the sampled tissue is in (fixed list; a metastasis at its site); see organ_source
metadata_v2.organ_source: luna = GPT-6 Luna Decisions choice; uberon_chain = taken from the UBERON term's is_a / part_of chain when that names a different organ; manual = human-review correction
metadata_v2.tissue_ontology_id: UBERON term (most specific supported by the text), chosen by Luna from candidates found in the text; null if none fits (always null for plants)
metadata_v2.sample_kind: primary tissue / tumour tissue / metastasis / organoid / cell culture / xenograft / whole embryo/organism / engineered tissue / unknown
metadata_v2.disease_status: normal / disease / perturbation (experimental intervention that is not a named disease) / not stated; a disease term judged true sets 'disease'
metadata_v2.disease_status_source: luna = Luna Decisions choice; manual = overrides_v2.csv; mondo_predicate = set to disease because a MONDO term was judged true while Luna chose another status (Luna's choice in brackets)
metadata_v2.disease_ontology_ids: MONDO terms judged true for this sample (most specific only; list, may be empty)
metadata_v2.disease_raw: disease as extracted from GEO by the SDA-All agent (v3 sample.json)
metadata_v2.condition_raw: condition as extracted from GEO by the SDA-All agent (v3 sample.json)
metadata_v2.life_stage: embryonic / fetal / neonatal or infant / juvenile / adult / aged / not stated; from age_raw by a fixed rule where the notation is unambiguous (mouse / rat: P, E, weeks, months, years; neonatal <= P21, juvenile < 6 weeks, adult < 18 months, aged >= 18 months; ranges use their midpoint when they span two stages; human: years, post-conception weeks), else Luna
metadata_v2.life_stage_source: age rule: <notation> (deterministic, from age_raw) or luna (GPT-6 Luna Decisions); 2.2 adds 'rule: culture or organoid (culture time is not a life stage)', 'age rule: days in an age series' and manual
metadata_v2.life_stage_luna: Luna's life-stage answer (kept when the age rule overrides it)
metadata_v2.sex_source: extracted field, sample text (the words male / female in title, source or characteristics), manual, or not stated (metadata 2.2 and later)
metadata_v2.donor_key: <published_gse>:<donor id>; donor IDs are only unique within a study
metadata_v2.organisms: all host species listed by GEO (list)
metadata_v2.co_detected_organisms: pathogens or microbes GEO lists with the host (e.g. Plasmodium berghei ANKA)
metadata_v2.xenograft: GEO marks the sample as a xenograft
metadata_v2.multi_species: more than one host species listed
metadata_v2.organism_basis: where organism comes from (GEO field, or the evidence used when GEO gives only a genus)
metadata_v2.feature_species: species implied by the features' Ensembl gene IDs (>= 90% of IDs share a prefix); differs from organism when reads were mapped to a related reference or a graft dominates (metadata_flags: feature_species_differs)
metadata_v2.preservation: FFPE / fresh frozen (incl. OCT-embedded) / fixed frozen / other; null = not stated
metadata_v2.platform_basis: release v3, or the GEO series text for corrected / named studies
metadata_v2.assay_name: specific assay (e.g. Visium CytAssist, Slide-seqV2, Open-ST, DBiT-seq); equals the platform when nothing more specific is known; 'not named in GEO' when the series text names no assay
metadata_v2.assay_type: imaging-based (in situ hybridisation / sequencing) or sequencing-based (spatial barcoding)
metadata_v2.technology_raw: technology as written by the authors
metadata_v2.pubmed_ids: PubMed IDs of the series (GEO) and of the sample record (list)
metadata_v2.dois: publication DOIs found in the sample record (list)
metadata_v2.annotation_version: version of the tissue / disease / life-stage annotation (sda-tissue-disease-2.x)
metadata_v2.annotation_confidence: Luna Decisions confidence per annotated field
metadata_v2.metadata_flags: consistency flags for review (list): normal_but_disease_text, tumour_marked_normal, low_confidence_annotation, feature_species_differs, ...
metadata_v2.annotation_min_confidence: lowest value in annotation_confidence (organ, sample kind, disease status, UBERON term, life stage) [client]
metadata_v2.platform_v3: release v3 value of platform (harmonized platform), kept where metadata v2 corrects or harmonizes it [client]
metadata_v2.organism_v3: release v3 value of organism (organism as written in GEO), kept where metadata v2 corrects or harmonizes it [client]
metadata_v2.sex_v3: release v3 value of sex (sex as reported), kept where metadata v2 corrects or harmonizes it [client]
metadata_v2.review_category_v3: release v3 value of review_category (review category), kept where metadata v2 corrects or harmonizes it [client]
metadata_v2.review_notes_v3: release v3 value of review_notes (review notes), kept where metadata v2 corrects or harmonizes it [client]
